# rule consequence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ruleConsequence`](gmeow-ruleConsequence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ruleConsequence>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A duty triggered when a rule is unfulfilled or violated — the ODRL consequence (on a duty) / remedy (on a prohibition). The deontic chaining that makes a policy enforceable.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Rule`](../classes/gmeow-Rule.md) -> [`gmeow:Duty`](../classes/gmeow-Duty.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ruleConsequence`](gmeow-ruleConsequence.md) from [`gmeow:Rule`](../classes/gmeow-Rule.md) to [`gmeow:Duty`](../classes/gmeow-Duty.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to chain a remedy or consequence duty to a rule — the [`gmeow:Duty`](../classes/gmeow-Duty.md) triggered when a duty is unfulfilled ([odrl:consequence](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/consequence)) or a prohibition is violated ([odrl:remedy](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/remedy)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a permission's required duty (that is [`gmeow:hasDuty`](gmeow-hasDuty.md)) and avoid pointing it at anything but a [`gmeow:Duty`](../classes/gmeow-Duty.md); the consequence is always itself a duty.

### How to use

- Add [`gmeow:ruleConsequence`](gmeow-ruleConsequence.md) from the violated rule to the triggered [`gmeow:Duty`](../classes/gmeow-Duty.md); this deontic chaining is what makes a policy enforceable.

### Examples

- ex:noCommercialUse [`gmeow:ruleConsequence`](gmeow-ruleConsequence.md) ex:payPenalty.
